race.description: Tyrepower East Albury F&M Mdn Plate
race.comment: JUNGLE LIGHTS (4) strengthened up over the with a plugging second over 1000m at Narrandera. Finds an easier contest and gets map favours today. On top in a suitable race. PETROULA (8) resumes today without a trial. Started a dominant fav when a fighting third over 1200m at Towong last March. Can surprise fresh with the key jockey change. SURREAL GRACE (10) failed to fire in ten career starts and can surprise fresh. Not a bad effort when fifth over 1200m at Wagga last March. Can add value to the exotics. BRILLIANT BEAGLE (1) back from 27 day let-up and has the benefit of a trial placing and is in with a chance.
